facts.label: Ofertas com will
facts.sub: Use I’ll + verbo base para oferecer ajuda na hora: I’ll help you. I’ll carry the pot. Não use to depois de I’ll.

facts.label: Ofertas
facts.sub: Para oferecer ajuda, use I’ll + verbo: I’ll help you. A forma curta I’ll quer dizer I will. É natural e simpática, e você usa quando decide ajudar na hora.

facts.label: Cozinha
facts.sub: Na cozinha, vários verbos servem para ofertas: I’ll cut, I’ll wash, I’ll cook, I’ll carry. Diga a tarefa logo depois de I’ll: I’ll wash the dishes.

pages.title: A warm kitchen · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday evening in a warm kitchen in Atlanta. Pots sit on the stove and the oven is on. Zoe cooks dinner for her family. Her friend Sal comes in with a smile. There is a lot of work to do. Sal wants to help.
“Hi, Zoe! The kitchen is very busy. I’ll help you.” says Sal. “Thanks, Sal! I’m making dinner for ten people.” says Zoe. “Wow! I’ll cut the vegetables.” says Sal.
